The Bourne trilogy of books consists of "The Bourne Identity" (1980), "The Bourne Supremacy" (1986), and "The Bourne Ultimatum" (1990), all written by Robert Ludlum. These novels were later adapted into the popular film series starring Matt Damon. All three agents have correctly identified Robert Ludlum as the author, and this is a well-established fact.
